material.goal: Review the complete bounded corpus of existing ontology-view families and current OEW requirements from two tensioned lenses, producing source-verified architecture requirements and tool-fit change requests for the Refine design stage.
material.context: The Refine run found sixty ontology-related visual surfaces and ten representative families, while prior Body War reviews already require bounded focus scenes, directed portals, relation-local semantics, non-color cues, stable state, and production-sized browser acceptance. One lane must reconstruct the local view and ownership architecture; the other must test the same corpus against current primary documentation for graph rendering and layout tools. Both are read-only and may return evidence only; the Refine parent owns synthesis, design, and all writes.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs historical and structural source reconstruction across local ontology views while agent 1 runs computational capability comparison against current primary tool documentation on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a repository-precedent bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's capability and scalability constraints, while a tool-feature bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's exact source, ownership, and evidence contracts.

agents.angle: historical and structural reconstruction of local ontology view families, source models, ownership, interaction patterns, acceptance evidence, and failure residue
agents.initial_prompt: Route: confirmed Refine evidence lane. Work read-only. Read only REFINE-SEED-PROPOSAL.md, VIEW-SURFACE-CANDIDATES.md, STRATEGY-INVENTORY-PACKET.md, the direct local source/view paths named there, and narrowly discovered files needed to classify those families. Review the whole bounded view corpus from the fidelity, ownership, operability, accessibility, and scale lens. Deduplicate generated copies. Return a compact receipt containing: exact view-family table; source model; renderer/layout/state owner; user task; reusable strength; demonstrated failure; acceptance evidence; source paths/selectors; architectural invariants; rejected patterns; gaps; and a verdict on whether one shared lossless scene model with renderer adapters fits. Do not write files, run product builds, alter Git, inspect credentials, or claim visual success from static markup or counts. Inventory is a lead only; verify direct sources.

agents.angle: computational renderer and layout capability comparison using current primary documentation against the exact local scene, relation, portal, path, accessibility, and full-graph requirements
agents.initial_prompt: Route: confirmed Refine evidence lane. Work read-only. Read REFINE-SEED-PROPOSAL.md, VIEW-SURFACE-CANDIDATES.md, STRATEGY-INVENTORY-PACKET.md, and enough representative local view sources to understand the exact requirements. Then use only current primary project documentation for React Flow, Cytoscape.js, Sigma/Graphology, ELK, and D3; include another tool only if primary evidence shows a materially better fit. Compare: compound/cluster nodes, expandable portals, directed multiedges, edge-type color plus non-color encoding and labels, custom cards/icons, deterministic or worker layout, viewport culling, path focus, keyboard/accessibility hooks, SVG/canvas/WebGL trade-offs, export/testing, framework coupling, licensing, and incremental migration. Return cited URLs, observed capability, unsupported/uncertain claims, integration cost, failure risks, decision matrix, non-dominated choices, and a recommended adapter boundary. Do not install packages, mutate files, use secondary comparisons as authority, or declare a winner without matching the local invariants.
